open_questions: Left click on open space flies there, so empty-space click cannot also deselect. Deselect is Esc or right-click on open space. OK, or should a click on the ship toggle it off?

Right-click menu appears only for planets that still allow an action (outpost or platform). Storage, asteroid packs and built planets have no allowed action, so no menu opens. Add a 'Fly here' item there?
Selected look is a cyan ring around the ship, and the menu is a plain PopupMenu. Change either?
handoff: Click the Pathfinder to select it (cyan ring). While selected, left click on a planet, storage, asteroid pack or open space flies there at once. There was no confirm dialog in code to remove: the old flow was click-to-fly, Shift+click for space, and the panel Fly here button, which stays. Right click on a planet with an allowed action opens a PopupMenu (Establish trading post, or Establish mining platform once the mining skill is learned, per Pathfinder.actions_for). Picking one flies and builds on arrival (request_fly_establish, saved as 'auto'; no cash gives the existing notice). Esc or right-click on open space deselects. Outpost builds now take 0.025 cycles (1.5 s); data_version 58; costs unchanged. Tutorial texts TUT_G0_FLY and TUT_G0_BUILD updated in English and Russian. Test suite: pass=3073 fail=0. No new test was added for the new flow.

details.how_to_try: Run the game, click the ship at Voltara, right-click the dim world, choose Establish trading post.
